{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check unique values in key columns
print('Unique arms:', df['arm'].unique())
print('Unique sites:', df['site'].unique())
print('Unique severity levels:', df['severity'].unique())
print('Unique sexes:', df['sex'].unique())

# Check distribution of response by sex
response_by_sex = df.groupby('sex')['responded'].mean()
print('\nResponse rate by sex:\n', response_by_sex)

# Check distribution of other variables by sex to see for confounders
sex_distributions = df.groupby('sex').agg({
    'age': 'mean',
    'biomarker_baseline': 'mean',
    'biomarker_final': 'mean',
    'severity': lambda x: x.value_counts(normalize=True).to_dict()
}).round(2)
print('\nDemographic and biomarker means by sex:\n', sex_distributions)"}
